caption: The drawing depicts the head and upper neck of a horse sculpted in a realistic style, rendered in shades of black, gray, and white, with a clear emphasis on the contours and details of the horse’s muscle and mane. The horse's head is shown in profile facing to the right, with both ears alert and forward. The horse has a metallic ring attached to its mouth area, suggesting it might be a decorative or functional sculpture piece, such as a hitching post or architectural ornament. The horse's head and neck merge into a cylindrical base adorned with geometric patterns and ridges. The background is plain, with the drawing centered and no additional objects or scenery. There is a small handwritten signature and date in red ink near the lower right part of the image, reading "Chas Moss 1934." The paper appears light beige in color, serving as the unembellished background.
title: Hitching Post
